notes:
Segment ministries-b1 = Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and its 6 departments, plus every attached/subordinate/statutory/autonomous body, CAPF and agency administered by MHA, per research/india/MINISTRIES.md Group B. As-of 2026-09-25.

COUNTS: 33 entities, 30 positions, 35 relations.

KNOWN GAPS / LOW-CONFIDENCE ITEMS (flagged rather than invented):
- Named current secretaries for 5 of the 6 MHA departments (Internal Security, States, Official Language, Border Management, J&K and Ladakh Affairs) could not be individually confirmed; only the overall Home Secretary (Govind Mohan) is confirmed. In practice these departments are typically headed by Special/Additional Secretary-rank officers under the Home Secretary's overall charge; positions are included with confidence low and no holder.
- BPR&D DG: conflicting/stale sources (Balaji Srivatsav 'since 2024-03-27' per one Wikipedia snapshot vs Rajeev Kumar Sharma 'DG until 2026-06-30' per another current-affairs source); left unresolved, holder omitted, confidence low.
- NCB DG (Anurag Garg): confirmed as current holder via Wikipedia infobox but exact appointment date unconfirmed; one secondary source cited an apparently-past tenure-end date (23 May 2026) that is inconsistent with him still being listed as incumbent — flagged, not resolved.
- SVPNPA Director: previous confirmed director (Amit Garg) moved to become NCRB Director in July 2026; his SVPNPA successor not confirmed.
- I4C (Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre) and DFSS (Directorate of Forensic Science Services): no current named CEO/Director General could be confirmed; entities included, heads omitted.
- Bureau of Immigration Commissioner and Registrar General/Census Commissioner's exact appointment dates not confirmed (names are confirmed).
- BSF/ITBP DG 'since' dates: MHA/press sources (theprint.in, ips.gov.in empanelment PDF) point to appointment orders dated 14-15 Jan 2026; one Wikipedia snapshot showed a conflicting 1 Dec 2025 date for BSF, likely reflecting an earlier interim appointment or unrevised infobox — used the more specific press-dated figure, flagged as medium confidence.
- MoS Nityanand Rai 'since' date: Wikipedia infobox still shows original 2019 assumption; used an approximate current-term date (9 June 2024, matching the Council of Ministers' swearing-in) since ministers are re-sworn for each new Lok Sabha term, but this specific re-oath date for Rai was not separately source-confirmed.
- Not included despite being plausible/real MHA-adjacent bodies, for lack of a fresh, reliable 2025-2026 source in this research pass: North Eastern Police Academy (NEPA), Central Detective Training Institutes (CDTIs) as an aggregate, any dedicated 'Sardar Patel Global Centre' IB training facility, and CyMAC as an entity distinct from I4C. These are flagged as follow-up research, not fabricated.
- Special Protection Group (SPG) was investigated and confirmed to sit under the Cabinet Secretariat (core-apex), NOT MHA, per Wikipedia — correctly excluded from this segment.
- CBI (Central Bureau of Investigation) is under the Department of Personnel & Training (Ministry of Personnel), NOT MHA — correctly excluded.
- Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep administrations are owned by the states-* segments and were only referenced (st-an, st-ld, plus st-ch, st-dh for Dept of States oversight relations), not redefined here.
- Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities is owned by the constitutional-bodies segment and was not defined here, per task instructions.
- This session's WebSearch tool budget was exhausted partway through research (shared across parallel segment-research subagents running concurrently) and the Wikipedia parse API began rate-limiting (HTTP 429) for the same reason; remaining research relied on WebFetch (still available) and curl against official portals. This capped the entity count below the 50+ aim in favour of not inventing unverified detail.

--- ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION PASS (2026-09-25) ---
See top-level 'verification' block for the full list of corrections/additions. Headline changes: fixed Amit Shah's house/constituency (stale pre-2019 Rajya Sabha data), fixed NDMA chairperson position (wrong rank + missing ex-officio holder), and resolved two of the file's own flagged gaps (SVPNPA Director, BPR&D DG) plus the NCRB Director confidence, all via a single confirmed 6 Jul 2026 Hindustan Times reshuffle article. Confidence raised (medium->high) on BSF/ITBP/SSB DGs, Delhi Police Commissioner and RGI after independent fresh re-checks. The 5 unconfirmed department-secretary positions, BOI Commissioner, and NCB DG's exact appointment date remain unresolved after this pass (no fresh source found) and are left as low/unchanged confidence rather than guessed.

entities.name: Ministry of Home Affairs
entities.description: Internal security, policing, borders, Centre-State relations, disaster management, census, citizenship and Union Territory administration for India.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Home
entities.description: Core home affairs: internal security coordination, police matters, VIP security policy, Union Territory administration, disaster management, and general administration of MHA.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Internal Security
entities.description: Handles internal security policy, Left-Wing Extremism, counter-terrorism coordination, Central Armed Police Forces deployment and modernisation.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of States
entities.description: Centre-State relations, administration of Union Territories, freedom fighters' pension schemes and inter-governmental coordination on internal matters.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Official Language
entities.description: Promotes and implements the use of Hindi as the Official Language of the Union under the Official Languages Act, 1963.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Border Management
entities.description: Border infrastructure, border guarding forces' coordination, Integrated Check Posts and border area development programmes.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Jammu, Kashmir and Ladakh Affairs
entities.description: Administers Union subjects concerning the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh following the reorganisation under the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Intelligence Bureau
entities.description: India's internal intelligence agency; collects intelligence within India and conducts counter-intelligence and counter-terrorism duties. Not a statutory body.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order (no dedicated statute); functions administratively under MHA

entities.name: National Investigation Agency
entities.description: India's federal counter-terrorism law-enforcement and investigation agency, empowered to probe terrorism and other scheduled offences across states without prior state consent.
entities.legalBasis: National Investigation Agency Act, 2008

entities.name: Narcotics Control Bureau
entities.description: Nodal drug law-enforcement agency responsible for fighting drug trafficking and abuse of illegal substances under the NDPS Act.
entities.legalBasis: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (NCB constituted 1986 under Section 4(3))

entities.name: National Crime Records Bureau
entities.description: Compiles and disseminates crime and criminal data for India, publishes the annual 'Crime in India' report, and runs the Crime and Criminal Tracking Network & Systems (CCTNS).
entities.legalBasis: Executive order (1986 Cabinet decision, no dedicated statute)

entities.name: Bureau of Police Research and Development
entities.description: Apex research, training-standards and modernisation body for the Indian police, sets standards for CAPF/state police training, forensics and equipment.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order (Cabinet resolution, 1970)

entities.name: Border Security Force
entities.description: Primary border-guarding force for India's borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh; also deployed in counter-insurgency and internal security roles.
entities.legalBasis: Border Security Force Act, 1968

entities.name: Central Reserve Police Force
entities.description: India's largest CAPF; principal force for internal security duties, counter-insurgency, Left-Wing Extremism operations, election security and VIP security (less SPG).
entities.legalBasis: Central Reserve Police Force Act, 1949

entities.name: Central Industrial Security Force
entities.description: Provides security to critical infrastructure installations including airports, metro systems, nuclear and space establishments, and major PSUs.
entities.legalBasis: Central Industrial Security Force Act, 1968

entities.name: Indo-Tibetan Border Police
entities.description: Guards the Indo-China (Tibet) border in high-altitude terrain and performs disaster-response and VIP security duties.
entities.legalBasis: Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force Act, 1992

entities.name: Sashastra Seema Bal
entities.description: Guards the Indo-Nepal and Indo-Bhutan borders and carries out border policing and counter-insurgency duties in the region.
entities.legalBasis: Sashastra Seema Bal Act, 2007

entities.name: Assam Rifles
entities.description: India's oldest paramilitary force; guards the Indo-Myanmar border and conducts counter-insurgency operations in the North-East. Administratively under MHA, operationally under the Army.
entities.legalBasis: Assam Rifles Act, 2006

entities.name: National Security Guard
entities.description: Federal contingency force specialising in counter-terrorism, hostage rescue and VIP protection ('Black Cats'); deployed on requisition for high-risk operations.
entities.legalBasis: National Security Guard Act, 1986

entities.name: National Disaster Management Authority
entities.description: Apex body for disaster management in India, laying down policies, plans and guidelines and coordinating their enforcement for prevention of and response to disasters.
entities.legalBasis: Disaster Management Act, 2005

entities.name: National Institute of Disaster Management
entities.description: Apex training, research and capacity-building institute for disaster management, deemed to be a university.
entities.legalBasis: Disaster Management Act, 2005, s.42

entities.name: National Disaster Response Force
entities.description: Specialist force for response to natural and man-made disasters, including CBRN emergencies; drawn on deputation from CAPFs.
entities.legalBasis: Disaster Management Act, 2005, s.44-45

entities.name: Directorate General, Civil Defence, Home Guards and Fire Services
entities.description: Coordinates the civil defence, home guards and fire-service organisations that support disaster response and civil protection across states.
entities.legalBasis: Civil Defence Act, 1968; Disaster Management Act, 2005 (fire services largely a state subject, coordinated centrally)

entities.name: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
entities.description: Conducts the decennial Census of India, maintains the Sample Registration System and civil registration (births/deaths) statistics, and administers the National Population Register.
entities.legalBasis: Census Act, 1948; Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969

entities.name: 2027 Census of India (16th Census)
entities.description: India's next decennial census, being conducted in two phases: House Listing and Housing Census (1 Apr-Sep 2026; Himalayan/snow-bound areas Oct 2025-Sep 2026) followed by Population Enumeration (9-28 Feb 2027, reference date 1 Mar 2027). Will include caste enumeration for the first time since 1931 and will be used for Lok Sabha delimitation and women's reservation implementation per the Delimitation Act, 2002.
entities.legalBasis: Census Act, 1948; Delimitation Act, 2002 (for downstream use of the data)

entities.name: Land Ports Authority of India
entities.description: Builds, upgrades and manages Integrated Check Posts (ICPs) at India's land borders to streamline cross-border trade and passenger movement.
entities.legalBasis: Land Ports Authority of India Act, 2010

entities.name: Bureau of Immigration
entities.description: Manages immigration control at India's international airports, seaports and land checkposts, foreigner registration (FRRO/FRO network) and immigration intelligence.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order under the Foreigners Act, 1946 / Passport (Entry into India) Act, 1920

entities.name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
entities.description: Trains newly-recruited IPS officers and conducts in-service police training programmes; India's premier police training institution.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order (MHA)
entities.established: 1948 (as CPTC, Mt Abu); moved to Hyderabad and renamed 1975

entities.name: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre
entities.description: Coordinates action against cybercrime nationally, runs the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) and the 1930 helpline, and hosts seven functional units including the Cyber and Multi-Agency Centre (CyMAC).
entities.legalBasis: Scheme approved by Union Cabinet, October 2018 (Cyber and Information Security Division, MHA)

entities.name: Delhi Police
entities.description: Police force for the National Capital Territory of Delhi; unlike other city police forces, reports directly to the Union Government (MHA) rather than the Delhi state government.
entities.legalBasis: Delhi Police Act, 1978
entities.established: 1861 (Delhi Police Act, 1978 gave the current statutory framework)

entities.name: Directorate of Forensic Science Services
entities.description: Apex forensic-science body coordinating the network of Central Forensic Science Laboratories (Delhi, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chandigarh, Guwahati, Bhopal, Pune) and setting forensic standards used by police and courts.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order (MHA)

entities.name: Narco-Coordination Centre
entities.description: Multi-agency coordination mechanism (Centre, State and district levels) chaired by the Union Home Minister to strengthen anti-drug-trafficking coordination among central and state agencies.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order (MHA)

entities.name: Crime and Criminal Tracking Network & Systems
entities.description: Nationwide networked IT system linking police stations to digitise FIR registration, investigation tracking and crime/criminal databases, operated by NCRB.
entities.legalBasis: Union Cabinet-approved Mission Mode Project under the National e-Governance Plan
